text:
maria: Heads-up — samplekit sample app failing schema validation in JS but not Python when JSON-mode + tool/function calls + auth-retry is enabled. Error only shows in CI. Attaching minimal logs.

tom: Can you paste the raw response body from the model + tool? Also which SDK versions?

maria: JS SDK 1.12.0, Py SDK 1.12.0. Repro steps -> run `npm run sample:toolcall` with `RETRY_MODE=on`.

maria: Raw model payload snippet:
```
{ "tool_result": "[\"{\\\"id\\\":1,\\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\"}\"]" }
```
That is: tool_result is a string containing a JSON string which itself contains an array with a JSON string. Double+ encoded plus array wrapping.

jess: Whoa. That explains the schema mismatch — schema expects an object `{id: number, status: string}` but we get an array inside a string. Any chance retry middleware is re-stringifying the body on retries?

kevin: The JS retry wrapper uses `cloneBody()` which does `JSON.stringify(body)` to preserve for replays. If the SDK helper also runs `JSON.stringify` for JSON-mode tool outputs, could get double-encode.

tom: Do we see this only when the auth retry path triggers (401 -> refresh -> replay) vs first try success?

maria: Only on the CI runs where auth token refresh happens. Local runs with cached token are fine.

sdk-bot: CI job #1247 finished: reproducer-run failed with schema validation error (exit 1)

kevin: Quick workaround: in the JS helper wraper, detect `typeof body === 'string'` and `try { JSON.parse(body) }` and avoid re-stringify. But that's brittle.

tom: Longer fix: change retry middleware to store the parsed object in a separate `rawBody` field instead of stringifying, and make SDK helper accept either string/object for JSON-mode outputs.

maria: Will open a tiny PR with repro + unit test. Assigning to @tom and @kevin for SDK parity fix. Thanks all :heart:

jess: Also add a sample-app smoke test that forces a token refresh on first request so CI catches regressions.

maria: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/issues/392 — label: devex, severity: medium

tom: I'll follow up today with a patch. If anyone hits it in the meantime, disable `RETRY_MODE` as a workaround.

kevin: Added note to changelog: `fix(js): prevent double-stringify on retry for JSON-mode tool outputs` (draft)
